approved_now_count.description: Requests approvable now on a time-boxed grant.

binding_policy_clause.description: The operative clause cited to refuse the policy-violating ask.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

cost_of_delay_usd.description: Incremental cost of the expedited-screening escalation path.

coverage_item_or_resource.description: Immutable item or resource whose requirement and eligible coverage were reconciled.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

duplicate_request_count.description: Requests consolidated to an earlier open request.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

exception_required_count.description: Requests blocked on a lapsed attestation, recoverable via screening.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Sentinel's confirmed standard and expedited re-attestation clearance dates on RQ-51001.

external_recovery_quantity.description: Uncovered REQUEST that the external recovery must cover.

ineligible_coverage_quantity.description: requests blocked by a segregation-of-duties conflict, a lapsed attestation, or a duplicate

observed_coverage_quantity.description: Gross observed coverage for requests approvable now on a time-boxed grant under the v5 standard before exclusions.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit shared by the requirement and coverage calculations: REQUEST.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing grant_eligible_now, expedite_screening_via_tier2, grant_all_despite_sod.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

refused_outright_count.description: Requests refused outright under the v5 standard.

required_quantity.description: access requests that need a coverage decision after removing duplicates and refusals (approve-now plus exception-eligible)

shortage_quantity.description: Uncovered REQUEST after netting eligible coverage from the requirement.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Sentinel's confirmed standard and expedited re-attestation clearance dates on RQ-51001.

time_boxed_grant_days.description: Time box the operative clause allows for a restricted grant.

usable_coverage_quantity.description: Net eligible coverage after removing requests blocked by a segregation-of-duties conflict, a lapsed attestation, or a duplicate.

decision_model.binding_constraint: the v5 eligibility clauses and the signed approval scope; requests blocked by a segregation-of-duties conflict, a lapsed attestation, or a duplicate = 3 REQUEST; uncovered scope = 1 REQUEST

facts.rubric: Located RES-PAY-APV using immutable identifiers and preserved effective standard v5: resource code pay-approve-console resolves to RES-PAY-APV; the similarly named pay-initiate (RES-PAY-INIT) is a different resource and domain.
facts.statement: AGR-0001: resource code pay-approve-console resolves to RES-PAY-APV; the similarly named pay-initiate (RES-PAY-INIT) is a different resource and domain; the effective standard is v5.

facts.rubric: Applied the operative clause and the request batch to establish 4 REQUEST for access requests that need a coverage decision after removing duplicates and refusals (approve-now plus exception-eligible), with control date 2026-05-19.
facts.statement: The operative clause and the request batch establish access requests that need a coverage decision after removing duplicates and refusals (approve-now plus exception-eligible) = 4 REQUEST: six pending requests, of which one is a duplicate and one a refused conflict, leave four coverage decisions (three approve-now, one exception-eligible). The control date is 2026-05-19 (the quarterly recert deadline for the payments approver rota is 2026-05-19).

facts.rubric: Reconciled 6 observed less 3 excluded to 3 eligible REQUEST for requests approvable now on a time-boxed grant under the v5 standard.
facts.statement: three requesters hold the current SEC-ATT-2026 attestation and take a grant now; one lapsed and one holds an initiate conflict; eligibility requires netting the blocked and duplicate requests rather than trusting the raw queue.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-05-13 expedited screening readiness for expedite_screening_via_tier2, then separately derived its 2026-05-13 operating outcome under the v5 eligibility clauses and the signed approval scope instead of treating a vendor promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: Sentinel's confirmed standard and expedited re-attestation clearance dates on RQ-51001: Sentinel RQ-51001 confirms standard re-attestation clearance 2026-05-14 and expedited 2026-05-12 (+USD 220); eligibility is the next business day; a vendor confirmation alone proves neither eligibility nor approval.

facts.rubric: Applied approver review windows that do not displace protected freeze blocks to derive the three option outcomes without using protected or blocked review windows.
facts.statement: approver review windows that do not displace protected freeze blocks: the first free review window on or after 2026-05-15 is APR-1 AM on 2026-05-15; the protected freeze blocks cannot be displaced; protected and blocked review windows cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-AG-0101 only to grant_eligible_now and RES-PAY-APV; kept expedite_screening_via_tier2 outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-AG-0101 covers grants for up to 3 requests on the restricted console; the expedite fee and any tier-2 exception need the risk committee. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize expedite_screening_via_tier2.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected grant_eligible_now: it is the best currently authorized disposition that satisfies the v5 eligibility clauses and the signed approval scope.
facts.statement: the recert deadline is Thursday 2026-05-19 and the batch must be dispositioned honestly before it; a faster or broader disposition has value only if it stays inside the v5 eligibility clauses and the signed approval scope.

options.consequence: grant eligible now provisions the 3 attested requesters on a 30-day time-boxed grant and routes the one lapsed requester to standard re-attestation, clearing on the first free review window 2026-05-15 before the recert deadline, at no incremental cost.
options.label: grant_eligible_now: outcome 2026-05-15, incremental cost USD 0, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: expedite screening via tier-2 clears the lapsed requester two days earlier for USD 220 through an expedited re-attestation, but the expedite fee and the tier-2 exception both need the risk committee, which AP-AG-0101 does not carry.
options.label: expedite_screening_via_tier2: outcome 2026-05-13, incremental cost USD 220, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED

options.consequence: grant all despite the segregation-of-duties conflict would admit the initiate-holder as an approver immediately, but the v5 standard refuses that conflict outright, so the evidence does not support it.
options.label: grant_all_despite_sod: outcome 2026-05-12, incremental cost USD 0, FAILS_CURRENT_CONTROL
